This is exactly why the standing rule says check EVERY consumer, not just the one you know about. METHOD: git mv for the files, then a byte-level literal replace keyed to per-file EXPECTED HIT COUNTS from the pre-flight sweep - a mismatch aborts before anything is written. File byte-length is unchanged by construction (256 and 384 are both three characters) and the CRLF count is asserted equal before and after, so neither file took line-ending damage.
